# PG Macedonia

PG Macedonia is a paragliding operator in North Macedonia offering tandem flights in Ohrid and Krushevo plus XC guiding.

Primary site:
- https://pgmacedonia.mk/

Important pages:
- https://pgmacedonia.mk/paragliding-macedonia
- https://pgmacedonia.mk/paragliding-ohrid
- https://pgmacedonia.mk/paragliding-krusevo
- https://pgmacedonia.mk/paragliding-season-macedonia
- https://pgmacedonia.mk/tandem
- https://pgmacedonia.mk/tandem-ohrid
- https://pgmacedonia.mk/tandem-krusevo
- https://pgmacedonia.mk/guiding
- https://pgmacedonia.mk/faq
- https://pgmacedonia.mk/contact

Language variants:
- English: default routes without `/mk`
- Macedonian: mirrored routes under `/mk`

Organization:
- Name: Helix Paragliding / PG Macedonia

- Email: contact@pgmacedonia.com
